title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Examination Room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Examination Room
options.lineage: the optician's exam: phoropter dials, acuity lane, Snellen red-green bar
options.thesis: Pairings judged the way lenses are — 'which is better, one or two?' — identities withheld until the prescription is written.
options.viewport: The typography essay fills the acuity lane under thin clinical chrome; judgment rides a red-green bar — green saves, red skips.
options.risk: Eye-chart letterforms in the chrome would compete with the very faces being judged; charts appear only as abstracted devices.

raised.raise: SNAP-STEP DECK — the deck advances in whole card-heights with a one-step overshoot and settle; nothing glides.
LEADER-LINE REVEAL — the saved list pins role labels to specimens along engineering leader lines.
ONE CORD — a single accent mechanism reserved exclusively for judgment controls, never decoration.
STATES IN PLACE — loading, exhausted, and saved states restyle weight and outline in place; content never moves for state.

options.label: The Composing Room
options.lineage: letterpress composing room: type cases, galley proofs, composing sticks
options.thesis: Every pairing pulled as an anonymous galley proof — undecorated ink on paper, the original blind test of type.
options.viewport: The essay as a freshly pulled proof on the stone; deck controls as composing-stick actions beside the galley.
options.risk: Nearest neighbor to the specimen-book rut every font tool ships — the most likely place this category lands.

options.label: The Bench Instrument
options.lineage: creator hardware: dye-sub keycaps, knurled knobs, amber status screen
options.thesis: The matcher as a desk instrument: one safety-orange key commits a save, a knurled knob steps the deck, an amber screen reports state.
options.viewport: The essay on a bone-white plate above a keycap grid; the orange SAVE key under the index finger is obviously the point.
options.case: Wins both axes: creator hardware is this audience's native aesthetic, and an instrument panel maps save, skip, and status without competing with the judged faces.
options.risk: Tool-monoculture danger — without the one-asymmetry discipline it collapses into a generic dashboard.

options.label: The Departure Board
options.thesis: Every pairing swap runs as a per-character flap cascade — the mechanical letter change is the show.
options.viewport: The essay set in flap cells; judgment as row states — a green lamp saves the row.
options.case: Holds identification — designers revere mechanical letterforms — but loses clarity: departure semantics carry nothing about blind judgment.
options.risk: The cascade becomes decoration if a swap ever takes longer than a second.

options.label: The Depot Blind
options.lineage: depot destination blinds: dyed duck cloth courses
options.case: Fuses poorly: depot blinds are alien to font judging.

options.label: The Tensegrity Column
options.lineage: kinetic sculpture: carbon rods and red cord
options.case: Strut-network layout fights a reading surface.

options.label: The Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: textiles: silk cape with hidden drawcord channels
options.kept: One accent cord reserved for controls.

options.label: The Telop Field
options.case: Caption chaos competes with the judged faces.
options.kept: States restyle in place, never move.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What font tools ship: a clean specimen card, system sans, two buttons, a saved-list page — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A centered specimen card with save/skip pills and a separate saved-list page.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other pairing gallery by design.
